From pool floats to premium boating accessories, we've made a splash with customers worldwide. As we continue to grow, were looking for an Amazon Brand Manager who is passionate about data, process, and creative problem solving to help us scale to new heights on Amazon.

From monitoring daily performance, managing listings, tracking keyword performance, and launching promotions this is an all-encompassing role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly organized environment.

Fluent in tools like ClickUp, DataDive, Datarova , and Amazon flat files. Excellent written and verbal communication. Proactive, self-motivated, and highly reliable.

Comfortable working remotely and managing multiple workflows at once. Comfortable working with Time Tracking software. Our benefits Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company. Competitive salary.
